title: WebSocket Public Upgrade (response)
description: Raw HTTP 101 handshake returned when the connection is successfully upgraded to a WebSocket streaming public market data. There is no JSON body — a successful upgrade is signalled entirely through the status line and Upgrade/Connection headers.

status.description: HTTP status code confirming the protocol switch.

Upgrade.description: Confirms the connection was upgraded to the WebSocket protocol.

Connection.description: Confirms the connection has been upgraded.
